Definition: from G2374; an aperture, i.e. window:--window.
BiblicalUsage: The word thyrís carries the sense of a window. In Acts 20:9, there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, and it appears again in 2 Corinthians 11:33.
TheologicalSignificance: A young man dozing in a window and a basket lowered through one show me God can use a windowsill and an escape route alike.
